partner_narrative_notes.positioning: DiDi/99 can own the first/last-mile orchestration around real ferry terminals without claiming to operate ferries today: app discovery, timed ground-to-water transfer, ticketing/booking handoff, driver staging, luggage handling and premium multimodal service.

notes: Use city-supported 99 evidence for Rio and Florianópolis. Use only country-supported inheritance for Angra.

Rio is the public-transport flagship: exact ferry geometry plus high observed boardings. Lead with 99 first/last mile at Praça XV/Charitas/Arariboia and a premium foiling layer, not replacement rhetoric.
Angra is the island-access flagship: orchestrate Rio/airport/road arrival to Cais da Lapa and timed transfer to car-free Ilha Grande. Keep cruise visitors as context, not route demand.
Florianópolis is a smaller proof point around a real boat-dependent community; start with Costa da Lagoa, not speculative open-coast routes.
Official DiDi city pages directly support Cartagena and Barranquilla.
Cartagena is the best near-term tourism product: DiDi airport/hotel pickup → La Bodeguita → Isla Grande/Barú, with a published operator fare and official terminal entries.

Barranquilla is a public-sector/future-infrastructure narrative. Position DiDi as demand aggregation and multimodal integration contingent on Río-Bus becoming operational; never imply current service.
